title: Design Sensei project configuration (.design-sensei.yaml)
description: Optional per-project settings. Every key is optional; missing keys fall back to skills/design-sensei/config/defaults.yaml.

design_variance.description: 1 = conventional and safe, 10 = highly experimental art direction.

visual_density.description: 1 = airy and sparse, 10 = dense and information-rich.

preferred_frameworks.description: Frameworks and libraries to prefer. Empty means follow the project's existing stack.

allowed_dependencies.description: none | existing | minimal | any, or an explicit allow-list of package names.

reduced_motion.description: respect = honor prefers-reduced-motion with a defined alternative; static_first = the default experience is static and motion is opt-in.

source_acquisition_mode.description: on_demand = sync a source the first time it is needed; full = expect the whole library to be present; offline = never touch the network.

output_detail.description: Size of the text output of `recommend` and `search`: brief = ids and one line each; normal = trimmed, relative paths (default); full = verbose, absolute paths. The --detail flag wins.
